create_DerivedWidget: create a DerivedWidget instance by passing a message string to the constructor
call_the_answer: call the_answer on a DerivedWidget instance to return the integer 42
call_argv0: call argv0 on a DerivedWidget instance to return sys.argv[0]
review_DerivedWidget_class: review the DerivedWidget class that extends Widget and adds the_answer and argv0 methods
test_DerivedWidget_inheritance: test that DerivedWidget correctly inherits from Widget and calls super init with a message
